summary: A disciplined, plan-first session: conventions and tests were read up front, the cookie-backed team architecture was reasoned through and verified against framework source, and all 63 tests passed on the first run. The agent then went beyond the spec — hardening SPA-navigation state, running lint, a diff review, and a manual end-to-end browser probe — before a final clean-build full test run. The only real waste was ~10 turns spelunking node_modules for a documented Cookie API.
